title: How is FDR connected to the star of Squid Game?
description: Four real photos connect Franklin D. Roosevelt to Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae.
hook: How is Franklin D. Roosevelt connected to Lee Jung-jae?

image.file: File:The Roosevelts with the King and Queen of England sailing on the USS Potomac, June 9, 1939 (cropped).jpg

links.line: In 1939, Roosevelt took King George the Sixth sailing, on the first American visit by a reigning British king.

image.file: File:Royal Air Force Bomber Command, 1942-1945. CH20901.jpg

links.line: During World War Two, the King met RAF bomber crews with his daughter, Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Prime Minister Boris Johnson G7 Summit Day One - 51242021245.jpg

links.line: As Queen, in 2021 she hosted Emmanuel Macron and the other G7 leaders in Cornwall.
And in 2025, Macron posed with Squid Game star Lee Jung-jae at a charity gala in Paris.
